segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner helps balance shine and reduces oiliness, including in the T-zone, without over-drying or leaving a heavy feeling.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin give mixed reports: some describe it as hydrating and barrier-supporting, while others experienced breakouts after a couple of weeks of daily use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or perioral dermatitis, consistently report no irritation or redness, describing the toner as gentle and calming.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin found it gentle, effective, and non-sticky, leaving skin smooth and plump.

concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report the toner strengthens and calms the skin barrier, describing their skin as smoother, more balanced, and less irritated with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers say the toner did not cause breakouts and some report it helped clear small blemishes, but two reviewers with combination skin describe breakouts, one significant after about two weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers frequently describe the toner as hydrating and plumping to the skin; one reviewer found it added little hydration and left skin feeling tight rather than nourished.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner reduces shine and balances oil production, particularly in the T-zone, without stripping the skin.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin report no redness or irritation from the toner, and some note a reduction in existing redness over time.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the toner helped fade some dark spots on the face.

extraits.titre: Great toner for my oily skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This brand is completely new to me, so I didn't have any expectations going in. Lately, I've found myself reaching for it more often, especially with the humid weather in my area. My skin has been extra oily from wearing sunscreen, and by the afternoon, I usually feel sticky and uncomfortable. To avoid breakouts and that heavy, stale feeling, I've been washing my face more frequently so I can reapply sunscreen. I've been using this toner after cleansing, and it really helps to balance my skin. It feels incredibly refreshing and calming after a hot day. After a few weeks of consistent use, I've noticed my skin is less oily and has a more natural glow. I'm excited to try more products from this brand in the future and hopefully they also work just as great!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have oily skin and larger pores, so I love to incorporate some chemical exfoliants into my skincare routine. I have somewhat sensitive skin so I def have to be careful with what I use. I've used this for a few weeks now, 2-3x a week and I like this product. It didn't break me out more or irritate me in any way, which I tend to notice with any type of products with chemical exfoliants. This was super gentle, had no scent or weird texture/stickyness, and did help with breakouts. However, I'm giving this 4 stars because this was almost too gentle. Though it did help my skin not get too oily and felt nice and moisturized after using + helped clear out small breakouts, i almost wish it was a bit stronger. However, as a toner, it really is solid. I would def consider this if you have very sensitive skin and want to try a gentle exfoliant.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't sure what to expect from this particular toner, as I have tried just about everything possible and my rosacea prone skin doesn't like alcohol or witch hazel, so that eliminates many of the toner products on the market. I've been using this toner for almost a month now and the texture you see my skin is simply amazing. This is unscented with dark packaging, all the boxes are checked!
